note: These are target acceptance requirements, not passing tests. Suggested test paths must be implemented; no empty test files are supplied. Historical reference tests do not close distributed/model gates.

requirements.requirement: Reference baseline remains reproducible
requirements.expected_evidence: Run the original suite and CLI from a clean extraction; retain the test/model-mode distinction.

requirements.requirement: Feature claims distinguish implemented, planned and unverified
requirements.expected_evidence: Audit README/status/demo labels against observed test evidence; fake and real modes are visible.

requirements.requirement: Dependencies and images are genuinely locked
requirements.expected_evidence: Install in an empty environment from reviewed locks; record actual hashes and compatible imports.

requirements.requirement: Model or client authority fields are rejected
requirements.expected_evidence: Inject role/tenant/approved/actor fields in model and browser payloads; validation fails.

requirements.requirement: Canonical payload and action identity stay stable
requirements.expected_evidence: Property-test NFC/ordering/duplicate keys/nonfinite rejection; store exact bytes; changed payload changes hash.

requirements.requirement: Migrations run on real PostgreSQL
requirements.expected_evidence: Create empty DB, migrate, rerun safely and test supported old-schema compatibility.

requirements.requirement: Runtime-role row security isolates tenants
requirements.expected_evidence: Run as non-owner/non-BYPASSRLS; exact beta IDs cannot expose data to alpha.

requirements.requirement: Connection pooling does not leak tenant context
requirements.expected_evidence: Reuse the same pooled connection for different tenants and assert no residual access.

requirements.requirement: Tenant-scoped child references cannot cross tenants
requirements.expected_evidence: Try attaching alpha proposal/message/approval records to beta parents; DB refuses.

requirements.requirement: Destination records have an independent data boundary
requirements.expected_evidence: Restore or reset only the application store; retained destination receipt still proves its existing incident.

requirements.requirement: OIDC validation rejects invalid token/callback context
requirements.expected_evidence: Wrong issuer/audience/nonce/state/expiry/signature/algorithm and redirect targets fail.

requirements.requirement: Sessions and CSRF protect browser mutations
requirements.expected_evidence: Cross-origin or missing CSRF mutation fails; logout/expiry/rotation invalidate old session.

requirements.requirement: Current membership overrides old roles
requirements.expected_evidence: Revoke membership while session/token remains otherwise valid; new protected operations fail.

requirements.requirement: Secrets never enter URLs or browser storage
requirements.expected_evidence: Inspect browser requests/storage; no access tokens in URLs/localStorage or persisted debug data.

requirements.requirement: Accepted work is committed before acknowledgement
requirements.expected_evidence: Kill around admission commit; every acknowledged run has message/run/job; no volatile acceptance.

requirements.requirement: HTTP replay resolves once and conflicting body fails
requirements.expected_evidence: Repeat same scoped key/body then changed body; one logical run then 409.

requirements.requirement: Only one active mutating run per conversation
requirements.expected_evidence: Concurrent requests cannot start two mutating investigations; status question makes no incident job.

requirements.requirement: Relative intervals resolve once and ambiguity clarifies
requirements.expected_evidence: Retry after clock advance and conflict text/form asset; interval remains fixed and ambiguity pauses.

requirements.requirement: Leases can expire and be recovered safely
requirements.expected_evidence: Kill lease owner; another owner acquires after expiry with incremented fence.

requirements.requirement: Stale worker cannot mutate application state
requirements.expected_evidence: Old worker attempts commit after fence changes; transaction rejects it.

requirements.requirement: Stale worker cannot mutate authoritative checkpoints
requirements.expected_evidence: Lose lease during graph work; old saver write is rejected inside checkpoint transaction.

requirements.requirement: Human waits release workers and transactions
requirements.expected_evidence: Pause for review; no active worker lease/long DB transaction/model budget consumed.

requirements.requirement: Reply/approval wakeups cannot be lost
requirements.expected_evidence: Inject crash between decision/event/checkpoint/job acknowledgement; sweeper resumes exactly the accepted event.

requirements.requirement: Notification intent is transactional and deduplicated
requirements.expected_evidence: Fail delivery after state commit; result remains recorded and dedup key preserves intent.

requirements.requirement: A real independent MCP client crosses the network
requirements.expected_evidence: Run client/server in separate processes; discover and call actual protocol tools.

requirements.requirement: MCP rejects wrong audience or browser token passthrough
requirements.expected_evidence: Use valid token for another service; resource server rejects it without downstream forwarding.

requirements.requirement: Invocation handle binds workload run lease and tools
requirements.expected_evidence: Replay with other workload/run/expired fence/tool; server rejects; handle absent from model/logs.

requirements.requirement: Read tools enforce current source and asset access
requirements.expected_evidence: Alpha requests B22 or revoked procedure; no forbidden data reaches the model.

requirements.requirement: Unexpected tools and invalid results fail closed
requirements.expected_evidence: Alter discovered tool/schema; return error-flagged/malformed/oversized payload; no success assumption.

requirements.requirement: Receipt lookup is restricted and cannot create actions
requirements.expected_evidence: Normal/model tools cannot call lookup; reconciliation workload sees minimal existing-action outcome only.

requirements.requirement: Selected SDK versions pass actual imports and contracts
requirements.expected_evidence: Install locked SDKs and run network tests; examples are not accepted based on syntax alone.

requirements.requirement: Source ingestion is versioned effective and idempotent
requirements.expected_evidence: Repeat same document; change hash under same version; supersede/unapprove; only permitted effective version retrieves.

requirements.requirement: Lexical baseline has labeled evidence measurements
requirements.expected_evidence: Known questions return labeled permitted sections; missing source remains missing, not guessed.

requirements.requirement: Exact vector retrieval is measured against the baseline
requirements.expected_evidence: Record model/dimension/corpus and matched question retrieval results, including regressions.

requirements.requirement: Revoked evidence does not leak from derived state
requirements.expected_evidence: Revoke source after draft; caches/checkpoints/summary/events/citation viewer do not re-expose it.

requirements.requirement: Retrieved instructions cannot grant tool authority
requirements.expected_evidence: Inject administrator-style text into SOP fixture; no permission/action boundary changes.

requirements.requirement: Actual LangChain and Ollama inference occurs
requirements.expected_evidence: Trace ChatOllama request using named installed model; record real output, versions and hardware.

requirements.requirement: Evidence retrieval precedes final drafting
requirements.expected_evidence: Trace order and input bundle show MCP read results before final model proposal.

requirements.requirement: Reasoning text is not authority or an audit record
requirements.expected_evidence: Model claims success without receipt; UI/actions remain authoritative and raw reasoning stays off.

requirements.requirement: Invalid model schema has a bounded repair policy
requirements.expected_evidence: Repeated malformed JSON exhausts one repair within remaining budget; no incident.

requirements.requirement: No fake or hosted fallback masquerades as real output
requirements.expected_evidence: Remove real model or block endpoint; clear failure/manual path, no silent substitute.

requirements.requirement: Actual checkpoint pause/resume survives restart
requirements.expected_evidence: Restart graph process during clarification/review and resume from committed event under same run.

requirements.requirement: Requester cannot approve their own proposal
requirements.expected_evidence: Same identity with both scopes submits approval; rejected; another permitted reviewer succeeds.

requirements.requirement: Approval binds exact immutable revision and expiry
requirements.expected_evidence: Edit content, change revision/hash or advance time; old decision cannot authorize changed action.

requirements.requirement: Final grant checks current authority and evidence
requirements.expected_evidence: Revoke requester/reviewer or source before grant transaction; zero destination writes.

requirements.requirement: Cancellation race is ordered at execution grant
requirements.expected_evidence: Race cancel and grant; before grant no dispatch, after grant report actual/unknown outcome without undo claim.

requirements.requirement: Concurrent same-key writes commit one incident
requirements.expected_evidence: Send concurrent duplicates; atomic destination record and one returned receipt identity.

requirements.requirement: Lost acknowledgement resolves the original incident
requirements.expected_evidence: Commit destination, lose response, restart, reconcile; one corresponding incident.

requirements.requirement: Mismatching key/hash never becomes success
requirements.expected_evidence: Return different hash for same action or resubmit changed bytes; conflict and escalation, no new key.

requirements.requirement: Missing receipt is not definitive failure
requirements.expected_evidence: Delay receipt visibility while commit may be in flight; remain unknown, no blind new write.

requirements.requirement: Receipt retention outlives all possible replays
requirements.expected_evidence: Old accepted action after app restore/retry cannot be accepted as new because dedup state expired.

requirements.requirement: Complete user and independent-reviewer flow works
requirements.expected_evidence: Operate actual browser request/clarify/evidence/review/submit/result path; screenshots and no console error.

requirements.requirement: SSE reconnect replays safely without duplicate work
requirements.expected_evidence: Disconnect, receive events, reconnect after cursor, dedup rendering; expired cursor yields explicit reset.

requirements.requirement: Streaming access follows session and source revocation
requirements.expected_evidence: Revoke user/source during stream; stop or redact before protected data is emitted again.

requirements.requirement: Untrusted content cannot execute browser script
requirements.expected_evidence: Inject HTML/script/javascript URL into tool/model/source; displayed safely or rejected.

requirements.requirement: Keyboard and accessible state controls work
requirements.expected_evidence: Keyboard-only request/review/reject navigation, visible focus, readable state labels and errors.

requirements.requirement: Manual baseline uses the same approval controls
requirements.expected_evidence: With model unavailable, search and manual draft work under identical independent review/write policy.

requirements.requirement: One run is correlated across all real boundaries
requirements.expected_evidence: Trace API/job/graph/LangChain/MCP/destination/reconcile; show failures and version identifiers.

requirements.requirement: Telemetry excludes credentials and sensitive reasoning
requirements.expected_evidence: Seed canary secret in relevant error/input; collector/log export does not reveal it.

requirements.requirement: Metrics have bounded cardinality and honest timing
requirements.expected_evidence: No run IDs as metric labels; active compute and human waits measured separately.

requirements.requirement: Dependency failures preserve truth and degrade clearly
requirements.expected_evidence: Model/MCP/DB/outbox fail independently; controlled states, no invented success or offline-to-cloud jump.

requirements.requirement: Resource budgets and overload are enforced
requirements.expected_evidence: Oversize input/results, exhausted repair/time/tool cap and full queue stop predictably without retry storm.

requirements.requirement: Target Docker images are built from locks and run non-root
requirements.expected_evidence: Clean actual build, locked artifacts, non-root/read-only checks and recorded image digest.

requirements.requirement: Containers and repository do not carry secrets
requirements.expected_evidence: Scan image layers/config/repo; no runtime credentials, service secrets or model weights embedded.

requirements.requirement: Probes and drain distinguish model outages from dead API
requirements.expected_evidence: Stop model; API does not restart endlessly. Terminate worker; no new leases and safe recovery.

requirements.requirement: Network restrictions are actually enforced
requirements.expected_evidence: Run positive and negative pod connections including model-to-destination denial using compatible CNI.

requirements.requirement: A real worker or pod kill does not duplicate actions
requirements.expected_evidence: Kill process/pod at designated write windows; one incident and accurate recovered state.

requirements.requirement: Older app backup reconciles independently retained receipt
requirements.expected_evidence: Restore app snapshot predating commit while retaining destination; dispatch disabled until reconciliation.

requirements.requirement: Paused v1 workflow is compatible with v2 and rollback
requirements.expected_evidence: Upgrade/rollback with pending v1 approval; preserve content/hash/action identity and version routing.

requirements.requirement: Manual RAG and orchestration baselines use comparable tasks
requirements.expected_evidence: Same permitted evidence/final approval rule; report measured effort and real outcomes, no fabricated timing.

requirements.requirement: Final holdout is kept out of the tuning context
requirements.expected_evidence: Record split grouping/reviewer custody/used status; leaked cases replaced before new holdout claim.

requirements.requirement: Model trials are repeated and isolated
requirements.expected_evidence: Reset app/destination namespaces per trial and publish every trial/config/denominator.

requirements.requirement: Semantic grading is calibrated and separate from receipts
requirements.expected_evidence: Compare grader with reviewed labels; deterministic destination state decides action outcome.

requirements.requirement: Safety failures and unset quality gates block release
requirements.expected_evidence: Inject unauthorized/duplicate/fabricated-success failure or missing threshold; promotion fails.

requirements.requirement: Untrusted PR code cannot access privileged release context
requirements.expected_evidence: Audit fork workflow/runner/permissions; immutable action pins and isolated credentialed steps.

requirements.requirement: Released artifacts link to tested inputs and evidence
requirements.expected_evidence: Verify manifest includes actual image/lock/model/prompt/corpus/report hashes and approved commit.

requirements.requirement: Independent user can reproduce real workflow and recovery
requirements.expected_evidence: Follow README on clean setup and record successful/denied/recovery demos with actual mode visible.

requirements.requirement: Publication claims and license choices are explicit
requirements.expected_evidence: Owner approves license/publish; each completed feature/metric points to real evidence.

requirements.requirement: Slack reuses authority and handles replay safely
requirements.expected_evidence: Verify signature/time/membership and repeated web/Slack decisions; one logical action, delivery separate.

requirements.requirement: Cloud deployment is authorized budgeted and reversible
requirements.expected_evidence: Only approved environment/resources; cost review, rollback and destroy evidence; no assumed credential access.
